crop.notes: A paragraph from the bottom of column 1 of 'Macon's Ring Gossip' (a column on Billy Edwards' victories); it ends mid-sentence ('who was credited') and continues at the top of the next column, which is not in the crop. The Allen mention itself is complete.

title.suggested: Ben Hogan Recalled as Allen's Opponent for the Title

summary.suggested: In a column on Billy Edwards' career, the St. Louis Republic recalled that Ben Hogan, who later reformed and became an evangelist, fought Tom Allen for the championship and gave him a fair fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic, St. Louis, Sunday Morning, May 10, 1896, page 14. Column datelined New York (Special Correspondence).

facts.fact: Allen fought Ben Hogan, later an evangelist, for the championship; Hogan gave him a fair fight

notes: Retrospective mention; no date or place given. The facts index has an unnumbered (000) entry about Allen being set to fight [Ben?] Hogan, which this supports that it was Ben Hogan.
